episodes.207562: A tropical wave moving over the islands lead to heavy showers and t-storms. Breezy east to east-southeast winds also persisted. The tropical wave resulted in thunderstorms with frequent lightning and strong wind gusts. Flooding, debris flow and thunderstorm wind damage were reported at the first day of the month.
episodes.208219: Three primary supercells developed in the late afternoon of November 1, 2025 over South Texas ahead of an approaching cold front. These supercells produced widespread severe weather  with hail stones as large as 3 inches observed over portions of the Coastal Plains along with sporadic wind damage.  Additional severe storms, albeit weaker, continued into the early evening over the Victoria Crossroads region producing large hail and even drifts of accumulated hail.  The event was highly unusual in its magnitude, as hail > 2.5 inches in diameter is rare over South Texas, but was even more anomalous in terms of its seasonal occurrence as it is the first ever documented 3 inch hail event to take place outside of the spring (March-June) in South Texas.||The large wind-driven hail produced widespread damage over the area, with the most significant property damage being observed over portions of San Patricio county, particularly along a corridor between Taft and Portland. The bulk of the damage consisted of body and windshield damage to vehicles,  along with damage to windows, siding, and roofs of residential structures. Unfortunately as this storm reached the coast it maintained its intensity and impacted the rookery islands along the South Texas coast resulting in the deaths of thousands of birds.
episodes.208800: A nearby shortwave trough and frontal boundary ignited a cluster of supercell thunderstorms near the Texas Coastal Bend during the afternoon/evening hours of November 1. These supercells shifted south-southeastward over the Gulf Waters and the lower Texas coastal counties, with one strong cell that originated near Alice producing numerous instances of large hail from quarter to golf ball size, as well as isolated wind damage.
episodes.208822: Thunderstorms formed along a cold front as it moved through South-Central Texas. Some of these storms produced large hail and damaging wind gusts.
